notes.title: [Release Hotfix] - 0101
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

This hotfix is primarily focused on addressing the feedback we received from players after the release.

HIGHLIGHTS:

[list]
[*]     Traditional Chinese language support has been added.
[*]     Prices of weapons have been optimized for a better gameplay experience.
[*]     Adjustments have been made to weapon aiming to increase accuracy when aiming.
[*]     The interact button has been remapped from F to E for improved user interaction.
[*]     The controllers page has been updated to provide better information about the controls.
[*]     Collected money is now correctly represented in the progress and finish bar.
[*]     Automatic reload functionality has been implemented for smoother gameplay.
[*]     Adjustments have been made to bot spawning for a more balanced game environment.
[*]     Several room glitches have been fixed to enhance overall game stability.
[/list]

notes.title: Release is approaching!
notes.notes:
[h2]Exciting Announcement! Our game, "HEIST FORCE," is launching in just one week! [/h2]

Get ready to become part of the elite Heist Force, embarking on thrilling and daring missions in the infamous underworld. Engage in high-stakes encounters with relentless police forces, unearth hidden safes, and orchestrate cunning bank heists that will leave you swimming in riches! Discover what makes "HEIST FORCE" an absolute must-play experience.

Featuring :
[list]
[*] Intense and adrenaline-fueled shooting combat, immersing you in fast-paced action-packed heist missions.
[*] Procedurally generated levels that will keep you on the edge, constantly exploring and feeling the thrill of getting lost in a labyrinth of challenges.
[*] A vast arsenal of weapons at your disposal, including our personal favorite, the precision-focused SNIPER, allowing you to take down enemies with unmatched accuracy.
[*] Challenging difficulties that will push your skills to the limit, with a multitude of levels offering endless replayability and endless opportunities to conquer new heights.
[/list]

[h2]Don't forget to tune in on July 25th to play HALVA Studio's first release![/h2]
